sources.title: CALA ledger — latest semantic/test mine

refs.purpose: atomic batch, overlap, duplicate-id, and sequential-equivalence corpus
account-set graph safety and atomic rejection corpus
balance floor/ceiling and atomic control attachment behavior
current Postgres lock protocol that must be replaced, not transliterated

caveats: This is not the intended Norn fork base; it is a separately pinned source for newer semantic and test evidence.
CALA does not establish Norn's per-unit conservation theorem.
Current code is deeply coupled to PgPool, Postgres advisory locks, JSONB, and TIMESTAMPTZ; only semantics and tests are portable without a substantial storage rewrite.

sources.title: CALA ledger — Norn fork base

refs.purpose: exact upstream tree from which a Norn quantity-ledger fork may be derived

caveats: Keep upstream notices and attribution, record every Norn divergence, and do not imply that latest-main test behavior exists in this tag.
The Postgres repository and locking protocol require redesign for Turso; this pin does not make a mechanical SQL rewrite safe.

sources.title: TigerBeetle
caveats: The replicated state machine, custom storage, batching, and accounting schema are co-designed and are not a reusable generic concurrency component.
Norn must re-express selected cases in its own typed transition vocabulary.

sources.title: Unified Code for Units of Measure
